title: Fix Field.error_messages type to allow dict and list values
description:
## Summary

Closes #1636.

The `Field.error_messages` parameter was typed as `dict[str, str]`, but error message values can be dicts or lists (e.g., the existing test `test_required_message_can_be_changed` already passes dict and list values). The `make_error` method also already handles non-string values correctly.

### Changes

- Added `ErrorMessageValue` and `ErrorMessages` type aliases to `types.py`
- Updated 4 type annotations in `fields.py` from `dict[str, str]` to `types.ErrorMessages`:
  - `_BaseFieldKwargs.error_messages`
  - `Field.default_error_messages`
  - `Field.__init__` parameter
  - Local `messages` variable in `__init__`

## Test plan

- [x] All 1132 existing tests pass (no test changes needed)
- [x] Existing test `test_required_message_can_be_changed` already validates dict and list error message values

diff --git a/src/marshmallow/types.py b/src/marshmallow/types.py
index 4c5d98da1..125a61411 100644
--- a/src/marshmallow/types.py
+++ b/src/marshmallow/types.py
@@ -15,6 +15,12 @@
 #: Type for validator functions
 Validator: typing.TypeAlias = typing.Callable[[typing.Any], typing.Any]
 
+#: Type for a single error message value, which can be a string, list, or dict
+ErrorMessageValue: typing.TypeAlias = str | list | dict
+
+#: Type for error_messages dictionaries passed to fields
+ErrorMessages: typing.TypeAlias = dict[str, ErrorMessageValue]
+
 #: A valid option for the ``unknown`` schema option and argument
 UnknownOption: typing.TypeAlias = typing.Literal["exclude", "include", "raise"]
